purpose: Teach: 炸裂/廃墟/米兵/不毛/飢餓/自決/滅亡/査察

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場で炸裂的な売上を狙うな、堅実でいけ
lines.en: Don't chase explosive market gains. We move steady and deliberate.
lines.style: Measured authority. Opens clean, no hesitation. Direct eye contact. Each phrase lands with quiet weight, not raised voice. The confidence of someone who doesn't need to convince—just inform.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。廃墟同然の工場を再生する案を出しました
lines.en: Understood. I've brought forward a proposal to revitalize that abandoned factory site.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Slight lean forward on the key point. Calm and direct—not overeager, just ready to report. The tone of someone who's done the groundwork.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、米兵向けの英語サービスも整備しろ
lines.en: And make sure we have English services in place for our American partners.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, continuing the thread. No pause between instructions—this is all one strategic vision. Clipped but not harsh. The cadence of ticking boxes on a larger plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不毛な内紛は社員間で起こさないようにします
lines.en: Yes. I'll make certain internal friction doesn't take root among the team.
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Slower pace—he's acknowledging the weight of that responsibility. Gentle but solid. Not a casual promise, but something he's absorbing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に飢餓を経験させぬ福利を整えろ
lines.en: Ensure the team has the benefits and security they need. No one should ever worry about falling through.
lines.style: Shift to something more deliberate, almost paternal. Slower word-spacing. This line carries conviction about duty, not just directive. A breath before 'security'—it matters to him.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営判断の自決責任を引き受けます
lines.en: Yes. I take full responsibility for those decisions and their outcomes.
lines.style: Steady and grounded. A slight deepening of tone—this is the moment he accepts the weight. No hesitation, no flourish. Just ownership. Clear, almost solemn.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、企業滅亡を防ぐ危機対応計画を作れ
lines.en: And develop a crisis response plan. Make sure we're ready for anything that threatens the company's survival.
lines.style: Returning to command cadence. Urgent undercurrent but controlled—not panicked. Each phrase is a small command. The seriousness settles in on 'survival.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。国際査察の対応マニュアルを整備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the international compliance manual ready.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Quiet but complete. A slight closing breath—he's received the full brief and is walking out ready. Professional, assured, not a word wasted.
